# Formatting

Plain text with **bold**, *italic*, ***bold italic***, ~~strikethrough~~,
==highlight==, `inline code`, and a %%hidden comment%% in the middle.
Escaped characters stay literal: \*not italic\*, \[[not a link]], \#not-a-tag.
Inline HTML such as <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> and <u>underline</u> is allowed.
A hard line break ends this line  
and this line continues after it.

# Heading 1
## Heading 2
### Heading 3
#### Heading 4
##### Heading 5
###### Heading 6

Setext heading
--------------

> that spans two lines.
>
> > A nested quote.

- Bullet two
